instructions: Complete each fixed practice task before any timed run; practice is unscored.
Begin only when the source, target format, and checklist are available, and finish after recording an artifact or controlled blocked outcome.
Do not access a gold answer, assessment result, or assessor feedback during practice or before timed work.
Record the package revision, package SHA-256, completion flag, and completion timestamp under the assigned pseudonymous participant ID.

manual_practice.task: Create an editable spreadsheet from the fixed practice source and complete the shared review checklist.
manual_practice.assistance_contract: Use a standard document editor only; do not use VeriDoc, another converter, a gold answer, or assessor feedback.

veridoc_practice.task: Create an editable spreadsheet from the fixed practice source with VeriDoc and complete the shared review checklist.
veridoc_practice.assistance_contract: Use VeriDoc conversion and review UI only; do not use a gold answer or assessor feedback.
